outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals FC Barcelona 3.00 vs Villarreal CF 1.19, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: FC Barcelona at home: 5W-0D-1L, 24 scored and 7 conceded in 6 games.
Villarreal CF away: 2W-2D-2L, 9 scored and 8 conceded in 6 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.60 goals per game, away teams 1.27.
Recent league form (newest first): FC Barcelona WWLWW, Villarreal CF WLWDL (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: FC Barcelona has 6 home games and Villarreal CF 6 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
